messages:
Ike: Quick triage — support seeing mixed guidance: console shows 'throttled' while API returns 503/429. Customers confused which playbook to run. We need clearer mapping between status codes, console badges, and client fields.
Rina: We should pick one canonical machine field in the body: `error_kind` (values: `capacity`, `quota`, `model`, `fallback`). Keep HTTP code semantics but rely on `error_kind` for programmatic decisions.
Sofie: Agree. Also add `short_hint` (one-line) and `sdk_retryable` boolean. Example response: { \"status\":503, \"error_kind\":\"capacity\", \"short_hint\":\"try again in 10s\", \"sdk_retryable\":true }.
Luis: Telemetry: emit `error_kind` as a top-level tag on all error counters. Sample full traces at 0.5% including route, model_version, and whether `fallback_applied` is present.
Ike: Console UX: badges should be verb-first and action oriented. Drafts: "Capacity pressure — retry" / "Quota hit — contact billing" / "Model failure — fallback used (details)". Badges link to runbook steps.
Rina: Rollout: feature flag on infra, 72h internal, expose in hosted API after sanity. Add migration note: old `INTERNAL` mappings will be advisory for 60 days then removed.
Sofie: SDKs: add `ErrorKind` enum and `shouldRetry()` helper. Also emit a single telemetry event when SDK decides to retry to help correlate.
Luis: Security: never put tenant IDs in response fields or headers. If support needs context, include it only in telemetry/traces behind RBAC. Add a linter rule.
Ike: Edge: fallback returns 200 but quality degraded. Add `fallback_applied:true` + `quality:degraded` in telemetry; console shows yellow badge and offer to file a quality ticket.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: `feature/error-kind` -> canary eng-prd-canary. Build 10789.
Rina: I'll draft the minimal RFC and a sample changelog snippet for docs.
Sofie: I'll create SDK PR template.
Luis: I'll add dashboards and alerts (>2% model errors -> page).
Ike: Thanks all, I'll coordinate follow-ups.
